newsitem.title: UK: Banesto sets $150 mln subordinated Yankee.
newsitem.headline: Banesto sets $150 mln subordinated Yankee.

text.p: Banco Espanol de Credito SA (Banesto) has launched a $150 million 10-year subordinated Yankee bond, lead manager Lehman Brothers said in a statement on Friday.
The bond pays a coupon of 7.50 percent.
"This transaction sets a new landmark for Banesto, which has been absent from the international capital markets since it was purchased by Banco Santander," Lehman said in the statement.

"The new management team, appointed by the Bank of Spain when the bank was rescued in 1994, and confrimed by Banco Santander, has completed the restructuring process of the bank," the statement said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7658
